description:
Keep game mods, saves and addons in sync between friends' PCs, over LAN or the internet.

SyncCrate makes every PC in a group match the host's mods, saves and addons, copying only the files that differ. Works over LAN without internet, or from anywhere with a join code. Supports 129 games, including The Sims 4, Minecraft, Valheim and Stardew Valley.
